capabilities: Incrementally fetch new scrobbles since the last sync
Create artist and album notes with playcounts and cover images
Backlink scrobbled tracks into their artist and album notes
Adjust UTC timestamps to a custom timezone and re-stamp existing track files
Backfill historical tracks, artists and albums up to custom limits
extras: Requires a free Last.fm API key the user must create; the README discloses network usage per community plugin policies, notes the plugin is unofficial and not affiliated with Last.fm, and states documentation and code were AI-assisted.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a user's Last.fm listening history and artist/album data into notes automatically.

relations.evidence: It makes outbound requests exclusively to the official Last.fm API

summary: Last.fm sync plugin that fetches scrobbles, top artists, albums and cover art into notes with properties for Bases.
